description: For each room's heat loss, works out the rated (delta T 50) radiator output needed at the system's flow and return temperatures, using output = rated x (mean water to air difference / 50) ^ 1.3. Shows how far an existing radiator falls short, the water flow per radiator, indicative lengths by panel type, and with compare_flow_temp_c how much bigger radiators must be at a lower flow temperature (for example 70 C boiler to 45 C heat pump). Typical call: {"flow_temp_c":45,"rooms":[{"name":"Lounge","heat_loss_w":1500,"existing_rated_output_w":1800}],"compare_flow_temp_c":70}.

return_temp_c.description: Default flow minus 10 (minus 5 at 55 C or lower).

existing_rated_output_w.description: The radiator's delta T 50 output, if one is fitted.

trade.description: Optional. The plumber or heating engineer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1, the same shape as Spark Pack and Nero Work). Used to prefill records and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Flow Pack.

categories.description: Trades offered, using Nero Work trade names. Defaults to ["plumber", "heating"].

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Northside Plumbing & Heating".

licence_body.description: Registration scheme. For gas work use gas_safe with the business's Gas Safe registration number.

licence_number.description: Scheme registration number (Gas Safe registration numbers are usually 6 or 7 digits).

name: size_radiators
title: Radiator size per room, including at heat pump temperatures
